user_query: I'm a scientist studying the correlation between solar radiation and air quality. Can you provide me with the radiation forecasts for the next week and the air quality forecasts for the next three days? Also, fetch the current air quality conditions for a specific location.

TaskList.description: Fetch the solar radiation forecasts for the next week.
Fetch the air quality forecasts for the next three days.
Fetch the current air quality conditions for a specific location.
